// Unqualified UVM class names must not be ambiguous at global scope
// after 'using namespace uvm' (no stray global forward declarations).

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

#include <iostream>

using namespace uvm;

// global-scope declarations using unqualified names
uvm_object* p = nullptr;
uvm_printer* q = nullptr;
uvm_event_callback* r = nullptr;

class my_callback : public uvm_event_callback
{
public:
  my_callback( const std::string& name = "my_callback" )
  : uvm_event_callback(name), pre_count(0), post_count(0) {}

  virtual bool pre_trigger( const uvm_event* e, const uvm_object* data = nullptr ) const
  {
    ++pre_count;
    return false;
  }

  virtual void post_trigger( const uvm_event* e, const uvm_object* data = nullptr ) const
  {
    ++post_count;
  }

  mutable int pre_count;
  mutable int post_count;
};

class test : public uvm_test
{
public:
  UVM_COMPONENT_UTILS(test);

  test( uvm_component_name name ) : uvm_test(name) {}

  void run_phase( uvm_phase& phase )
  {
    phase.raise_objection(this);

    uvm_event ev("ev");
    my_callback cb;
    r = &cb;

    ev.add_callback(r);
    ev.trigger();
    sc_core::wait(sc_core::SC_ZERO_TIME);
    ev.reset();

    ev.delete_callback(&cb);
    ev.trigger();
    sc_core::wait(sc_core::SC_ZERO_TIME);

    std::cout << "pre_trigger calls: " << cb.pre_count
              << ", post_trigger calls: " << cb.post_count << std::endl;

    r = nullptr;
    phase.drop_objection(this);
  }
};

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  run_test("test");
  return 0;
}
